v7_figure.caption: of Republicans and of Democrats back a ban on stock trading by members of Congress
v7_figure.qualification: From a University of Maryland Program for Public Consultation survey of 2,625 registered voters (May 2023). The House passed a ban 232 to 198 on July 22, 2026. On September 30, 2026 the Senate fell short of the 60 votes needed to take it up, 53 to 47.

notes: The 86 percent overall figure is in the survey source note (N40), not in the headline figure caption.
DR-98: a chart names "H.R. 7008, the Stop Insider Trading Act" with both provisions at first mention; the spec carries those words.

The Program for Public Consultation gives the full sample’s margin of error as plus or minus 1.9 percent (https://publicconsultation.org/united-states/stock-trading-by-members-of-congress/, read November 11 and 12, 2026); it gives none for each party’s voters and states no confidence level.
